name: Lambda Resource
description: Register a LambdaResource (invoke an AWS Lambda function) for use by other components -- a reusable, injectable invoke() method rather than a single-purpose asset.
author: Dagster Community

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

region_name.label: Region Name
region_name.description: AWS region, e.g. 'us-east-1'. Omit to use the default boto3 credential/region chain (env vars, profile config, instance role).

profile_name.label: Profile Name
profile_name.description: Named AWS CLI/SDK profile. Omit to use the default boto3 credential chain (env vars, instance role, etc.).

aws_access_key_id_env_var.label: Aws Access Key Id Env Var
aws_access_key_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the AWS access key ID.

aws_secret_access_key_env_var.label: Aws Secret Access Key Env Var
aws_secret_access_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the AWS secret access key.

aws_session_token_env_var.label: Aws Session Token Env Var
aws_session_token_env_var.description: Env var holding a temporary AWS session token, paired with the access key/secret above.
